rows.answer: According to the error analysis comparing YOLO with Fast R-CNN [1][2][3], YOLO struggles to localize objects correctly. Localization errors account for more of YOLO's errors than all other sources combined. Specifically, 19.0% of YOLO's top detections are localization errors.
According to the error analysis pie chart in the paper "You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection" [1][2][3], 4.75% of YOLO's detections are background errors.
According to the YOLO error analysis chart, 65.5% of YOLO's top detections are correct [1].
